festivalsNote: Lunar month = game S.month (1..12); tuan = game tuần index (0 thượng 1-10, 1 trung 11-20, 2 hạ 21-30). A festival picture replaces map-<season>-<buoi> during its tuần; for a buổi with no festival picture, fall back to the season picture. Same framing as the season pictures (measured: 0 px shift on all 14), so the hotspots are unchanged.
